title: 30A Beach House Coconut Cottage Panhandle Getaways
meta_description: 30A Gulf Side Beach House Rental, Coconut Cottage in Seagrove Beach, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. One Level Living, No Stairs
description_expanded: Description Description 30A Gulf Side Beach House Rental, Coconut Cottage in Seagrove Beach, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. One Level Living, No Stairs Public beach access is just down the street, with a community pool, boutique shopping, restaurants, and a variety of activities all within walking distance. This home is a long time family favorite, and its location in Seagrove Beach has all the great community energy that makes 30A so special. Free Activities Included. see details below*** FEATURES * Beach House - Seagrove Beach* Golf Cart Included * Living Area - Smart TV * Front Porch with Seating * Covered Screened In Back Patio * Heated Outdoor Shower * Fully Equipped Kitchen with Breakfast Bar * Dining Area * Bedroom 1 - King Bed, Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom * Bedroom 2 - Queen Bed, Smart TV * Bathroom 2 - Tub/Shower Combo * Bedroom 3 - Queen + Twin Bed, Smart TV * Parking for 3 Cars * Pack n Play Available * Washer / Dryer * FREE Wi-Fi * Sleeps 7 30A Beach Access Points Bonus***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens & towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach. WI-FI INFORMATION Please be advised that while we do offer free Wi-Fi, service in the area can be spotty regardless of provider. Should you require stable internet service for work or pleasure; please bring an ethernet cord to plug into the router or bring access to a hot spot with you. Limited tech support. No refunds for any interruption in Wi-Fi service during your stay, NO exceptions. Read more

Extras, Services & Complimentary Items: 1 Complimentary Round of Golf Each Day (March - Oct)
